status.summary: Redcar and Cleveland Borough Council's highways engineering team commented on 14 October 2026 on the pending full application R/2026/0337/FFM for a data centre campus (Use Class B8) of data-centre buildings, power and communications buildings, backup generators and associated infrastructure on the former Invista site at Wilton International, raising no objection subject to conditions after reviewing revised transport information. This dated council record of the live application supports announced status as of 14 October 2026. The register records no decision; no consent, site preparation or construction is established.
